name: clearings
description: Documentation tooling for the Clearings agent routine runtime

scripts.docs:check: npm --prefix website run typecheck && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run docs:build && npm run docs:check && npm run sdk:check
scripts.sdk:check: node website/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --strict --noEmit --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module ESNext sdk/clearings.d.ts tests/sdk-types.ts
scripts.web:typecheck: node scripts/prepare-docs.mjs && npm --prefix website run typegen && npm --prefix website run typecheck
